name: Holotropic breathwork

copy.intent: Holotropic breathwork is in the library for reference. It cannot be guided in this app.
copy.end: If you want to learn it, look for a qualified, in-person teacher.
copy.notice: This is not medical advice. If you have a health condition or feel unwell, speak to a qualified clinician before you practise.

note: Excluded: a two to three hour facilitated format with a Sitter, deliberate fast deep breathing, long practitioner exclusion lists and no controlled safety data. Kept as a reference entry only (plan section E1).
